mosaicary.consent.title: Show your new skin to other players at once?
mosaicary.consent.text: Everyone sees a new skin once you join a server again. Players with Mosaicary can see it straight away: for that the mod tells mosaicary.com which skin you put on and asks which ones the players around you put on. The skin goes on either way; you can change this later in the wardrobe settings.
